Those unordered pairs split into S1,S2,S3,O0,O1,O2 with state multiplicities (2,2,2,1,2,2)*n. Explicitly applying the physical one-edge token slide and verifying the result remains distance<=3 gives degrees (4,6,2,4,6,4), total 11n states, 24n edges and degree polynomial 2nt^2+5nt^4+4nt^6. Moves change distance parity, establishing bipartiteness, and constructive S-type/O-type routes show connectedness. The common-neighbor identity for four-cycles gives per-type square incidences (8,7,1,8,12,6); their weighted sum is 76n, hence 19n unoriented squares. The local types remain stable for n>=8 including wraparound threshold; independent power-domination propagation and reconfiguration enumeration over n=8..12 checked counts, square totals, connectivity and degree spectrum. These finite n checks do not replace the uniform local-type argument.
